# Global Copilot Instructions

- Tech Stack: Static HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Demo data currently uses browser local storage.
- User Roles: superadmin, admin, user. Default role for all signups in DEV is 'superadmin'.
- Security: Treat browser-stored authentication and data as demo-only. Add backend authorization and database policies only when a backend is introduced.
- Git Strategy: Never commit directly to main branch. Always create feature branches.
